paper: Mild synthesis of C6 + higher alcohols from aqueous ethanol upgrading over Ni@MB catalyst derived from melt-blown cloth

validation.evidence: The Ni@MB catalysts were fabricated through a facile impregnation-carbonization strategy using melt-blown cloth (MB) and Ni(NO3)2⋅6H2O as staring materials.
validation.reason: The catalyst Ni@MB is explicitly identified in the text.

validation.evidence: Preferably, the catalyst with Ni/MB ratio of 1/20 exhibited best higher alcohols yield of 46.9 % with C6 + higher alcohols selectivity of 66.7 %.
validation.reason: The catalyst Ni@MB-1/20–500 is explicitly identified in the text.

validation.evidence: The XRD diffraction pattern: (a) Ni@MB-X-500 catalysts.
validation.reason: The catalyst Ni@MB-X-500 is explicitly identified in the text.

validation.evidence: The ethanol coupling catalytic activity using Ni@MB-1/20-T catalysts prepared at different carbonization temperatures were shown in Fig. 8.
validation.reason: The catalyst Ni@MB-1/20-T is explicitly identified in the text.

validation.evidence: For comparison, the Ni@CA catalyst was also prepared using same method except adopting citric acid (CA) as staring material instead of MB.
